design.name: 连鼓灵·鼓
design.brief: One of the six small barrel drums of the Liangu, modelled separately: the ring of six is assembled in the engine.
design.turnaround_lead: ONE small barrel drum from the Liangu's ring
design.turnaround_pose: , standing upright on one drumhead: a short barrel body of dark weathered wood with copper studs around both rims, grey-blue hide drumheads on top and bottom painted with a spiral cloud-and-thunder pattern, two small bronze lugs on opposite sides where it joins the ring; nothing attached (no ring, no other drums, no core)
design.turnaround_digits: Both drumheads, every copper stud row and both lugs fully inside the frame; in the side views the barrel profile must be clearly readable.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
